PUNJAB HEALTHCARE COMMISSION HUMAN RESOURCES
REGULATIONS, 2023
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
2nd March February, 2023]
Notification
No. PHC/NOT./2023/24, dated 28-02-2023.--- In exercise of the power conferred under Section 40 of the Punjab
Healthcare Commission Act, 2010 (Act XVI of 2010), the Punjab Healthcare
Commission is pleased to publish the draft "Punjab Healthcare Commission
Human Resources Regulations, 2023" to invite thereon, public
opinion(s)/suggestion(s)/objection(s), if any, which may reach the office of
the Commission, 185-Ahmed Block, New Garden, Town, Lahore within fifteen (15)
days of the publication of this Notification.
Opinion(s)/Objection(s)/Suggestion(s) received after the stipulated time will
not be considered:
CHAPTER I - PRELIMINARY
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1)
These Regulations may be called the
Punjab Healthcare Commission Human Resources Regulations, 2023.
(2) These
Regulations shall come into force at once.
(3) These
Regulations shall apply to all employees of the Commission.
2. Definitions:--- (1) In these Regulations, unless there is anything
repugnant in the subject or context: -
(a) "Act"
means the Punjab Healthcare Commission Act, 2010.
(b) "Appointment"
means the acceptance of an offer of employment, made by the appointing
authority, by an applicant culminating into a mutual agreement.
(c) "Base
Station" means any office of the Commission where an employee is posted on
orders of the Competent Authority to carry out his duties and includes
Regional/Divisional offices as well as the Head Office.
(d) "Board
Secretary" means an officer nominated by the Board to act as secretary to
the Board. This role has been conferred to Director Human Resources and Support
Services at Punjab Healthcare Commission (PHC).
(e) "Break
in Service," means the period of leave without pay of an employee from
service of the Commission.
(f) "Competent
Authority" means the Board, the Human Resources Sub-Committee of the
Board, or any other officer authorized by the Board to perform such functions
as may be delegated.
(g) "Completed
Year of Service" means a period of twelve months from the date of
continuous service of an employee with the Commission and each successive
period of twelve months.
(h) "Consultant"
means a person with whom the Commission enters into an agreement for services
or products deliverable.
(i) "Day"
means a calendar day, beginning and ending at midnight.
(j)
"Demotion" means the reduction of an employee to a lower position or
grade.
(k)
"DHS" means Director Human Resources and Support Services, formerly
Director Business Support (DBS)
(l) "Director"
means a director, in the service of Punjab Healthcare Commission.
(m) "Directorate"
means any Directorate of Punjab Healthcare Commission.
(n) "Duty"
means time spent on work assigned by the Commission/Competent Authority and
includes time spent on authorized travel/tour and leave; and/or any extra work
to be performed, under the orders/directions of the Competent Authority.
(o) "Employee"
means an individual legally hired for a wage, salary, fee, or payment to
perform work for the Commission.
(p) "Family"
means parents, spouse, and children of the employee, residing with and wholly
dependent upon him.
(q) "Fare"
means the price of conveyance or passage in a bus, train, airplane, or other
vehicles.
(r) "Gender"
means and includes
male, female, and
transgender.
(s) "Grade"
means a group of positions sufficiently similar with respect to their duties
and responsibilities that the same title may be reasonably and fairly used to
designate each position allocated to that grade. Substantially the same minimum
qualifications may be required and the same range of compensation may be
applied with equity.
(t) "Holiday"
means a day declared as such, by order of the Commission and includes optional
or national/local holiday(s), announced by the Provincial/Federal Government.

means Hu
